'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[June 2023 Jenin incursion]]
***Six [[Palestinians]] are killed and 90 others are injured during an [[Israeli Defense Forces|IDF]] raid in the [[Jenin refugee camp]] in the occupied [[West Bank]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/6/19/deaths-injuries-as-israeli-forces-raid-jenin (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/6/20/sixth-palestinian-killed-in-israeli-raid-on-jenin-refugee-camp (Al Jazeera)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*The mayor of the [[Nepal]]i capital of [[Kathmandu]], [[Balen Shah]], bans the screenings of [[Cinema of India|Indian films]] after dialogue in the recent [[epic film]] ''[[Adipurush]]'' stated that [[Sita]] from [[Hinduism|Hindu]] [[mythology]] was born in [[India]] instead of Nepal. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/6/19/nepal-capital-bans-indian-films-amid-row-over-adipurush-dialogues (Al Jazeera)]

'''Business and economy'''
*Indian [[low-cost airline]] [[IndiGo]] reaches a deal with European [[aerospace manufacturer]] [[Airbus]] to order 500 [[Airbus A320 family|A320]] aircraft, which will be delivered from 2030 to 2035, making it the largest single [[purchase agreement]] in [[commercial aviation]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2023/06/19/business/airbus-indigo-plane-deal-biggest-history/index.html (CNN)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
* [[Titan submersible implosion|''Titan'' submersible implosion]]
**The [[submersible]] ''[[OceanGate#Titan|Titan]]'', carrying tourists to the [[Wreck of the Titanic|wreck]] of the [[Titanic|RMS ''Titanic'']], is reported missing, with the [[United States Coast Guard]] attempting to locate the missing vessel. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/titanic-submarine-missing-rescue-mission-underway-newfoundland-canada/ (CBS News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*The [[United Nations General Assembly]] unanimously adopts the [[High Seas Treaty]], the first [[treaty]] aimed towards [[marine conservation]] in [[international waters]]. [https://thehill.com/policy/international/4057169-un-adopts-first-treaty-governing-the-high-seas/ (''The Hill'')]
*A report to the [[Japan]]ese [[National Diet]] revealed that from the end of [[World War II]] to 1996 over 25,000 Japanese citizens were forcibly sterilized under their [[Eugenics in Japan|eugenics law]], including two nine-year-olds. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-65958119 (BBC News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Qatar–United Arab Emirates relations]]
**The foreign ministries of [[Qatar]] and the [[United Arab Emirates]] announce that they will restore diplomatic relations and reopen their embassies in [[Doha]] and [[Abu Dhabi]], after relations were suspended six years ago during the [[Qatar diplomatic crisis]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/6/19/uae-qatar-reopen-embassies-after-years-long-diplomatic-rift (Al Jazeera)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Moldovan protests (2022–present)|Moldovan protests]]
**The [[Constitutional Court of Moldova]] outlaws the [[Șor Party]] after accusations that the party was trying to undermine the rule of law during the recent protests in [[Moldova]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/moldova-bans-pro-russian-shor-party-after-months-protests-2023-06-19/ (Reuters)]
*[[Commons Privileges Committee investigation into Boris Johnson]], [[Partygate]]
**[[Member of Parliament (United Kingdom)|MPs]] vote to support the report issued by [[Parliament of the United Kingdom|Parliament]] into former [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|Prime Minister]] [[Boris Johnson]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-65953605 (BBC News)]
*Six people are killed and eight others injured in a [[shootout]] between rival gangs on a street in [[Guayaquil]], [[Guayas Province|Guayas]], [[Ecuador]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230620-six-dead-eight-wounded-in-ecuador-gang-shooting (AFP via France 24)]

'''Sports'''
*[[Racism in association football]]
**The [[New Zealand men's national football team|New Zealand national team]] abandon their [[Exhibition game|friendly]] against [[Qatar national football team|Qatar]] at half-time in protest at a Qatari player's alleged use of a [[List of ethnic slurs|racial slur]] against New Zealand [[Defender (association football)|defender]] [[Michael Boxall]], who is half [[Samoan New Zealanders|Samoan]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2023/06/20/sport/new-zealand-qatar-match-abandoned-racial-abuse-spt-intl/index.html (CNN)]
